title: Add dark mode toggle to settings page
details: In the web-app repository, add a dark mode toggle to the settings page. Turning it on switches the whole app to a dark theme, and turning it off switches back to light. Save the choice so it is still set after a reload. If no choice has been saved yet, follow the operating system's colour scheme preference. Reuse the existing styling and theming approach. Make sure text and controls stay readable in both themes.
